rows.description: Open-source orchestrator and ADE for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and other AI coding agents in parallel — locally or 24/7 on your own server.
Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
Native client for Herdr on macOS, Linux, and Windows, built with Rust and GPUI. View terminal sessions, workspaces, Git worktrees, and agent activity through your local Herdr daemon.
